releases.name: Aero the Acro-Bat Legacy + Sunsoft Lost Gems
releases.summary:
The legend of Aero returns!

Aero the Acro-Bat Legacy + Sunsoft Lost Gems is an exclusive collection of six classic platform and action games brought together in one place. 

Dive into a colourful, high-energy retro experience featuring Aero, Zero, and a cast of unforgettable characters from a golden era of gaming. 

Whether you're reliving childhood favourites or discovering cult classics for the first time, this definitive bundle is packed with nostalgia, challenge, and side-scrolling fun.

releases.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
releases.summary:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them… the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.

Each level is filled with festive adventures. Hop through the Grinch’s Cave, dodging falling stalactites and zipping down watery chutes. Conquer Mt. Crumpit’s slippery ice and giant rolling snowballs. Find your way through Who-wood’s towering trees and springy mushrooms. Then explore Who-ville, leaping across hovering platforms and sneaking into the Whos’ cozy homes. Use your candy canes to break objects and release dazzling ornaments to decorate the Grinch’s Christmas tree and Who-ville Square.

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen!

releases.name: NASCAR 26
releases.summary: Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase! And, with all the laser scanned assets of iRacing, the level of authenticity has never been higher with dynamic track, an all new peak performance training mode, and enhanced driving physics across every chassis. And, with our new cross-play multiplayer feature, you can take on all your friends and show them who's best! NASCAR 26 brings all the thrills and excitement of race day, right to your living room. Are you ready to start your engine?

releases.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
releases.summary:
When Moomintroll unexpectedly wakes up early from his winter hibernation, he finds himself completely alone for the first time, in a world he barely recognizes. 

The familiar landscape of Moominvalley is now cloaked in the frosty veil of the Lady of the Cold. Initially seeking someone to care for him and longing to banish winter, young Moomintroll reluctantly embarks on a journey into the unknown, learning to forge new friendships and help those in greater need than himself.

releases.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
releases.summary: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

releases.name: Fading Echo
releases.summary:
Explore the surreal landscapes of the floating islands of Corel as a young Legend on a quest to discover her past and secure her future. Unleash chain reactions as you learn to control the elements in a fast-paced desert punk action-adventure. 

Use water as a weapon in all its forms. Seamlessly transform between liquid and human forms to navigate Corel’s surreal landscapes and battle its dangers. Dissolve into a droplet to slip through cracks and spread water across your surroundings, surge through tubes, crash down as a water bomb, or ascend in a vapor burst. 

Traverse Corel and its Shadows, distorted realities of the same world, each with its own laws, dangers, and possibilities. Explore landscapes both familiar and alien to unlock precious Aetheric Sources, discover new ways to interact with the world and adapt your approach to each dimension.

releases.name: PATLABOR the Case Files
releases.summary:
Labors. The generic term for robots developed for industrial use. Widely adopted in construction and civil engineering, crimes involving Labors rapidly increased. The Metropolitan Police Department established the Special Vehicle Section 2 Patrol Labor Squadron to counter this threat. Thus the "Patlabor" was born.

Relive numerous iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this home console 3D action game. Play from different perspectives - Main Missions as Special Vehicle Section 2, and Another Side Missions as their adversaries.

Over 20 Labors appear in the game Master everything from the Ingram to the Griffon and Type Zero Includes Simulator Mode where you can engage in shooting practice and Labor-vs-Labor combat.

releases.name: Flamecraft
releases.summary:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. 

Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft.

Gather and manage resources, enchant the shops using artifacts, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.

releases.name: FOUNTAINS
releases.summary:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that the malevolent Usurper shall slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is an action-RPG about fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime.

Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire?

releases.name: FOUNTAINS: Shattered Shape
releases.summary: Runner Squared is an endless runner game that tests your reflex skills where the objective is to jump over and under squares avoiding to get blocked off!Collect coins during gameplay to purchase upgrades to increase  your player's abilities and buying new skins, allowing you to reaching a better high score than your friends!

releases.name: Au Revoir
releases.summary:
Immerse yourself in a dystopian future with "Au Revoir," a point-and-click adventure game that brings back the classic style of the 90s. 

In the year 2068, Au Revoir Ltd. revolutionized the world with synthetic brains that store human consciousness, allowing the rich to live forever by transferring their minds to new bodies after death. You will play as Tristan, a Sentinel for Au Revoir, tasked with retrieving these consciousnesses. During a routine mission, Tristan begins to suspect failures in his own synthetic brain. 

In "Au Revoir," your investigative skills and choices will determine the outcome. You will face moral dilemmas and decisions that could change the fate of everyone.

releases.name: Object Factory
releases.summary: ** THIS VERSION HAS NO IN GAME ADS **Get ready for the most realistic off road buggy game you've ever played! RC Buggy Racing HD is a thrilling race game where you're up against other RC Buggy race cars out in the desert.Will you win the race?

releases.name: Better Mart Simulator
releases.summary: Short the chain to solve the puzzles and change the level, in this awesome physics based game. Accumulate coins and share them with your friends, Game Center enabled. Features: - simple control - swipe the finger and cut the rope - realistic physics - 18 different puzzles - amazing graphics - Game Center Play now...

releases.name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
releases.summary:
Once upon a time, the founder of alchemy led people from a dying world to a new land. In this fertile and harmonious land where man-made "Gods of Creation" act as guardians, humans lead a peaceful existence.

However, a long time has since passed, and the "Dust" of death began to engulf Arcaus. Gods gone mad become heinous "Gods of Misfortune" and begin to devour the world, and ash demons born of dust bare its fangs at the living. Like burnt pieces of paper and worm-eaten clothes, the world finds itself in an era where the earth was being eroded by the ashes.

The people were not entirely unprepared, however. Alchemists who wished to carry on the miracles brought upon by its founder gather at the Cagliostro Academy, a school boasting the highest levels of wisdom.

Among them is another - a young alchemist who knocks on the doors of the academy with aspirations in mind.

releases.name: Crazy Climber
releases.summary: Thousands of people from around the world take their memory sports seriously. Recalling a shuffled deck of 52 playing cards is a staple of many memory competitions. People stretch their memory prowess to the limit to recall an entire deck in mere minutes.If you like exercises that flex your memory, Card Master is the game for you. Have fun and do something that will help exercise the old noggin!Features:- Choose how many cards you want to memorize and recall. You don't need to start with 52 cards!- Three speeds.- Intuitive interface that allows you to recall cards quickly.- Times your recall and tracks errors.- Save your top 5 high scores!Have a question? info@frontpocketmedia.com

releases.name: Shape of Dreams
releases.summary: If you like "Ant Smasher" or "Bubble Smash" you will like this game. Endless dice smashing game in the wild west theme. Smash and survive all waves of dice as long as you can.------ HOW TO PLAY ------* Smash dice before they hit the ground,* Use tap, multitouch or swipe to destroy them,* Survive as long as you can in endless battle,* Crush 'em all in proper order to get the best score,* Game play trailer http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XnNzrSdEaSw------ FEATURES ------* 16 types of dice to crush,* 5 different game modes,* Difficulty level increases in time,* Free play in Sandbox mode (design mode),* Active pause (bullet time effect),* Advanced combo system,* Get all 7 Sheriff Badges,* Fast-paced and addictive game play,* Moody western atmosphere,* Share results on Facebook or Twitter,* Game Center support,* iOS 4.3 or above,* Universal app,------ STORY ------Far, far away, in the wild wild east some dice had an argument about who should go first. Now, as all the dice cannot come to an agreement, it is your job to restore the right order in their world. Do it before it’s too late and remember that small is beautiful.------ LINKS ------Follow us https://twitter.com/BladkoLike us https://www.facebook.com/bladko4mobileWatch us http://www.youtube.com/user/BladkoFunomobile

releases.name: Kernel Hearts
releases.summary: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

releases.name: ENDLESS Legend 2
releases.summary: Lead your people to victory on an ever-evolving world in this strategy game featuring asymmetric factions led by powerful heroes. Build your empire, wield political influence, and raise grand armies to wage war in a race to uncover dark secrets buried within the planet.

releases.name: Dacholer
releases.summary: Check out this fun princess fairy dash racing game.Slide your finger to create a catapult for the fairy to bounce and collect coins and power ups. Touch the fairy powerup to dash at sonic speed through the forest. Fun for all ages.Try it out today!

releases.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
releases.summary: Turn the page on the explosive 2nd chapter of Nihon Falcom’s legendary Trails saga! Estelle Bright sets out on a new journey across Liberl to uncover the truth behind Joshua’s disappearance and defeat the sinister Ouroboros organization.

releases.name: Sniper Dan
releases.summary: This app keeps the whole family busy! Do you like puzzles? Then try these fun and educational high-quality puzzles designed for kids and their parents!The difficulty level can be adjusted individually – there is something for everyone. Colourful graphics, sounds and effects top-off the play experience. This app is suitable for kindergarten kids as well as school kids. You can adjust the difficulty by clicking on the light bulb (preview of the puzzle on/off) and by choosing the number of pieces the puzzle should have (4, 9, 16 or 25). Features: • In total 20 puzzles, cute graphics and kid-friendly sounds and effects • A preview of the puzzle can be manually set (on/off), depending on the needs of your child • Four exciting themes are waiting for you: Fairy Tale, Underwater Ocean Life, Transportation, Outdoor Activities• A fun pop-the-balloons mini-game at the end of the game 5 puzzles (fairy tale puzzles) are free, more games (three more themes) can be easily purchased in-game.

releases.name: AKIBA LOST
releases.summary:
13 years ago, six girls mysteriously vanished in Akihabara - an unsolved case known as “Akiba’s Spirited Away.”

At the annual Game Show, Daiki Shinjo, once hailed as a “genius creator,” boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST. But the moment he does, strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi - each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

Yet, the story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.

It all begins with a threatening phone call - and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Cancel the game’s development - or the tragedy will repeat itself."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect his friends? Who is behind it all? And what really happened thirteen years ago?
